description.zh: 安全组名称，支持英文+数字+英文短划线(-)、下划线(_)。长度限制英文64字符。
description.en: The name of the security group. Letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_) are supported. The maximum length is 64 characters.

title.zh: 创建媒体直播输入安全组

descriptions.zh:
- 调用本接口创建媒体直播输入安全组。

## QPS 限制
本接口的单用户 QPS 限制为 50 次/秒。超过限制，API 调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
## QPS limit

This operation can be called up to 50 times per second for each Alibaba Cloud account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you may experience service interruptions. We recommend that you take note of this limit when you call this operation.
